note: Teal-and-orange split tone: shadows pushed to teal (rs down, bs up), highlights pushed to orange (rh up, bh down). Measured on flat patches: input 40 grey -> 9,21,33 (teal), input 128 -> 136,123,104 (orange), input 192 -> 213,200,181. The average hue barely moves because the two ends cancel - that is the look working, not the grade failing, so do not judge this one by a mean-hue number. Saturation comes DOWN to 0.95 because the split itself adds apparent colour.
